notes.title: Update note for 27 Jan 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Screen resolution fix. All screen resolutions should now be supported with display resolutions being detected.
[*] Added awards for Firm Season Rankings. Awards will be awarded to members of firms that finish 1st, 2nd or 3rd in the Season Rankings (Profit) for each season.
[/list]

notes.title: Firm Rankings - Update notes for 19 Jan 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Firm rankings now available (accessible via Firm Rankings tab in the Firms screen)
[*] Firm rankings reset to the start of this season.
[*] Firm rankings by alltime rating, lifetime profit, season profit and average season profit per member.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 8 Jan 2025
notes.content:
The first minor update is released!
Improvements in this update are as follows:
[list]
[*] Addressed CPU usage
[*] Improved scroll speed in windows
[*] Added Sort and Search features for main stock market listing
[/list]
